featureOverviewLead.message: Find what AI-MarkDone can do and where to use each feature.

featureOverviewNoMatches.message: No matching features. Try another search term.

featureOverviewSectionReaderSummary.message: Reply reading, heading outline, excerpts, and follow-up questions.

featureOverviewReaderFocusDescription.message: Read long replies in a clear layout with headings, lists, tables, code, and formulas.

featureOverviewReaderOutlineDescription.message: See the current reply’s heading structure and jump to the section you need.

featureOverviewReaderOutlineNote.message: Shown when there are at least two headings; turn it off in Reader settings.

featureOverviewReaderPagesDescription.message: Read collected replies one at a time without repeatedly scrolling through a long page.

featureOverviewReaderPositionDescription.message: Return to a reply or reopen Reader on the same page and resume where you stopped.

featureOverviewReaderPositionNote.message: Reading positions last for this page session and reset after a refresh.

featureOverviewReaderCodeDescription.message: Copy individual code blocks or wrap long lines for reading; turn syntax highlighting off if needed.

featureOverviewReaderExcerptsDescription.message: Keep important passages from different replies together for comparison; reorder or remove excerpts.

featureOverviewReaderExcerptsNote.message: Excerpts last until the page is refreshed, including when Reader is reopened. Bookmark previews have no excerpt tray.

featureOverviewReaderSendDescription.message: Write your next question while reading; the draft stays in sync with ChatGPT until you send it.

featureOverviewReaderLocateDescription.message: Return from the reply you are reading to its original conversation to see the surrounding content.

featureOverviewReaderSeparateDescription.message: Read a long conversation in a separate tab when scrolling on the ChatGPT page slows down.

featureOverviewReaderSeparateNote.message: Experimental. Keep the original ChatGPT tab open to refresh, send, or locate messages.

featureOverviewSectionNavigationSummary.message: Finding replies and keeping your place in long conversations.

featureOverviewNavigationDirectoryDescri.message: Find replies by their question summaries in compact previews or an expanded list; loaded history gradually joins the directory.

featureOverviewNavigationDirectoryNote.message: On by default for new installations; existing settings stay unchanged. Unloaded history may be missing.

featureOverviewNavigationPreviewDescript.message: Preview another reply without leaving your reading position, then open Reader or Export from it.

featureOverviewNavigationStepperDescript.message: Move between adjacent replies with less manual scrolling; arrow keys still move the cursor while typing.

featureOverviewNavigationSendPositionDes.message: Keep your position when possible after sending while reading earlier messages, reducing interruptions from jumps to the bottom.

featureOverviewNavigationSendPositionEnt.message: Settings → Reading & messages → Restore reading position after sending

featureOverviewCopyMarkdownDescription.message: Keep headings, lists, tables, code, and formula markup for further editing in notes or documents.

featureOverviewCopyMarkdownEntry.message: Reply toolbar or Reader → Copy Markdown

featureOverviewCopyQuestionReplyDescript.message: Copy the question and answer together with role labels to share their context.

featureOverviewCopyQuestionReplyEntry.message: Reply toolbar → Hover Copy Markdown → Copy question + reply

featureOverviewCopyImageDescription.message: Turn the current reply into an image for pasting into chats or documents.

featureOverviewCopyImageEntry.message: Reply toolbar → Hover Copy Markdown → Copy as PNG

featureOverviewCopySelectionDescription.message: Copy only the passage you need with formatting; formulas stay complete and partial code selections keep the selected text.

featureOverviewCopySelectionEntry.message: Reply or Reader text selection → Copy

featureOverviewCopySelectionNote.message: On ChatGPT, change the shortcut to Cmd/Ctrl + C or turn it off. Reader uses Cmd/Ctrl + C.

featureOverviewExportFormatsDescription.message: Save one or several replies as Markdown, PDF, or PNG; pack multiple images in a ZIP and view progress or cancel generation.

featureOverviewExportFormatsEntry.message: Reply toolbar or directory preview → Export

featureOverviewExportFormatsNote.message: PDF uses your browser’s print dialog; choose Save as PDF.

featureOverviewExportImageSettingsDescri.message: Choose mobile, tablet, desktop, or custom width and adjust resolution for your sharing needs.

featureOverviewExportImageSettingsEntry.message: Settings → Copy & export → Message PNG images

featureOverviewInputNewlineDescription.message: Use Enter for new lines in a long question; send with the button or Cmd/Ctrl + Enter.

featureOverviewInputBoldDescription.message: Add or remove visible bold markers on selected text to emphasize key points.

featureOverviewInputListsDescription.message: Continue, insert, split, or delete list items with automatic numbering, and exit empty items.

featureOverviewInputListsEntry.message: ChatGPT input; Settings → Writing & prompts → Input enhancement

featureOverviewInputPromptLibraryDescrip.message: Save frequently used instructions, assign triggers, and search, edit, reorder, disable, or delete them.

featureOverviewInputPromptLibraryEntry.message: ChatGPT page controls or Settings → Writing & prompts → Prompts

featureOverviewInputPromptTriggerDescrip.message: Use a backslash and trigger word to insert a saved instruction without retyping it.

featureOverviewInputPromptTriggerEntry.message: ChatGPT input or Reader send box → \trigger

featureOverviewInputPromptCursorDescript.message: Place the cursor where you need to fill in text after inserting a prompt.

featureOverviewInputPromptNotesDescripti.message: Insert a selected prompt with current-conversation annotations into a draft for revision or follow-up questions.

featureOverviewInputPromptNotesEntry.message: Prompt suggestions in the input → Right arrow

featureOverviewSectionFormulaSummary.message: Formula writing, previews, copying, and export.

featureOverviewFormulaSourceDescription.message: Copy an individual formula’s LaTeX source for further editing.

featureOverviewFormulaFormatsDescription.message: Set separate output formats for single formulas and whole-message Markdown to suit different editors.

featureOverviewFormulaSuggestionsDescrip.message: Insert common LaTeX snippets while writing a formula and use Tab to move between placeholders.

featureOverviewFormulaSuggestionsEntry.message: Inside a formula in ChatGPT input → Backslash command

featureOverviewFormulaPreviewDescription.message: See the formula at your cursor before sending the draft and catch writing mistakes early.

featureOverviewFormulaPreviewEntry.message: ChatGPT input → Formula; Settings → Writing & prompts → Formula assistance

featureOverviewFormulaAssetsDescription.message: Copy individual formulas as PNG, SVG, or MathML, or save PNG or SVG; configure replies and input previews separately.

featureOverviewFormulaAssetsEntry.message: Reply formula or input preview → Export actions; Settings → Buttons → Formula

featureOverviewFormulaAssetsNote.message: Enable image buttons for reply formulas first. SVG and MathML require available formula source.

featureOverviewSectionLibrarySummary.message: Saved replies, search, and folder organization.

featureOverviewLibrarySaveReplyDescripti.message: Save a reply and its question to read or copy from Library, or revisit the original conversation.

featureOverviewLibrarySavePageDescriptio.message: Save a conversation’s name and link to reopen it later.

featureOverviewLibrarySavePageNote.message: Page bookmarks save a name and link, not the full conversation.

featureOverviewLibrarySearchDescription.message: Find bookmarks, annotations, and highlights separately; sort bookmarks by name or date, or filter page and message types.

featureOverviewLibraryFoldersDescription.message: Group bookmarks by topic, rename folders and bookmarks, or move them to another folder.

featureOverviewLibraryBatchDescription.message: Select a page or all filtered results to move, delete, or export several bookmarks at once.

featureOverviewLibrarySummariesDescripti.message: Save space by keeping the beginning and end of each question and reply; read the full text in the original conversation.

featureOverviewLibrarySummariesEntry.message: Settings → Data & backup → Library → Save only bookmark excerpts

featureOverviewLibrarySummariesNote.message: Text longer than 500 characters keeps 250 from the start and 250 from the end.

featureOverviewMarksAddNoteDescription.message: Attach your thoughts to selected source text so the context is ready for later revisions.

featureOverviewMarksAddNoteEntry.message: Reply or Reader text selection → Annotation

featureOverviewMarksSaveAnnotationsDescr.message: Keep new annotations after a refresh and share saved annotations between ChatGPT and Reader.

featureOverviewMarksSaveAnnotationsNote.message: Off by default. New annotations then last only for this page session; previously saved annotations remain.

featureOverviewMarksHighlightDescription.message: Mark key passages in mist blue, cream yellow, or light coral; highlights save automatically and can be recolored later.

featureOverviewMarksHighlightEntry.message: Reply or Reader text selection → Color swatches

featureOverviewMarksHighlightNote.message: Works with regular text, complete inline code, and formulas; code blocks and tables do not show color swatches.

featureOverviewMarksNotesManageDescripti.message: Find, edit, or delete annotations and highlights, open their conversations, recolor highlights in batches, or insert annotations into the input box.

featureOverviewMarksNotesOutputDescripti.message: Combine source passages and annotations into a follow-up with an optional prompt, then preview, copy, or insert into a send draft.

featureOverviewMarksNotesOutputEntry.message: Reader → Copy annotations / Send → Insert annotations; current-conversation annotation manager

featureOverviewMarksNotesTemplateDescrip.message: Set how source text and annotations appear together, place a prompt before or after them, and choose time or text order.

featureOverviewMarksNotesTemplateEntry.message: Reader settings or Library annotation details → Copy template

featureOverviewMarksOrganizeDescription.message: Give conversations custom names and organize their annotations and highlights in folders; new marks keep the same location.

featureOverviewSectionSettingsBackupSumm.message: Interface preferences, Library backups, and settings transfer.

featureOverviewSettingsAppearanceDescrip.message: Choose light, dark, or page-matched appearance, accent color, text size, and ChatGPT content and input widths.

featureOverviewSettingsButtonsDescriptio.message: Choose which page, reply, formula, selection, and directory buttons appear, and keep common actions visible.

featureOverviewSettingsContentRulesDescr.message: Choose whether Reader, whole-reply copying, and message exports keep links and code blocks.

featureOverviewSettingsContentRulesEntry.message: Settings → Reading & messages → Content to keep

featureOverviewSettingsContentRulesNote.message: By default, link destinations are removed and code blocks kept. Saved bookmarks and explicit selections are unchanged.

featureOverviewBackupLocalDescription.message: Take bookmarks, saved annotations, highlights, and folders with you, and preview the merge before importing.

featureOverviewBackupLocalEntry.message: Settings → Data & backup → Local backup; Library → Import

featureOverviewBackupLocalNote.message: Does not include unsaved annotations, excerpts, prompts, or settings.

featureOverviewBackupDriveDescription.message: Manually back up Library, preview an earlier backup before restoring, and manage backups you no longer need.

featureOverviewBackupDriveNote.message: Experimental. Uploads only when you choose Back up now; this is not automatic syncing.

featureOverviewBackupSettingsTransferDes.message: Reuse preferences elsewhere, preview differences and choose categories before importing, or restore the settings from before an import.

featureOverviewBackupSettingsTransferNot.message: Configuration files contain preferences only, not Library, prompts, account credentials, or custom annotation templates.
